Prices include VAT. Full tank = tank size × price per litre; monthly cost = (distance × litres per 100 km ÷ 100) × price. A car driving 2,000 km a month at 8 litres per 100 km needs 160 litres, or SAR 348.80 with gasoline 91.

Frequently asked questions

What are petrol prices in Saudi Arabia in 2026?

Gasoline 91 is SAR 2.18 a litre and gasoline 95 SAR 2.33, unchanged since July 2021. Diesel is SAR 1.79 from 1 January 2026, up from 1.66.

Do Saudi petrol prices change every month?

Not for 91, 95 or diesel; Aramco reviews them once a year at the end of the year. Gasoline 98, launched in January 2026, is priced monthly.

How much does a 60-litre tank cost?

SAR 130.80 with gasoline 91, 139.80 with 95 and 107.40 with diesel.

Do the prices include VAT?

Yes, pump prices include 15% VAT.
